unsupported: Lydia Design Studio operates from Atlanta, Georgia, where head designer Lydia founded the company to provide domestic apparel manufacturing services.

Its workflow covers design consultation, hand sketching, pattern-making, sample development, fabric cutting, sewing, printing, finishing, and a three-stage inspection process at pre-cut, mid-sew, and post-finish stages.
The founder, Lydia, personally oversees each project to ensure quality and alignment with the client's vision.
